lesson: Risk Parity (Maillard et al. 2010 ERC) on 30 Korean stocks with 120-day Ledoit-Wolf covariance is counterproductive vs EW. SR degraded 0.857→0.800, CAGR 13.43→11.7%, MDD worsened 34.31→37.91%. Root cause: Korean mid/small-cap correlation structure is regime-dependent and estimation-noisy at N=30. RP requires stable covariance (works better at N>50 or with shrinkage targets tuned to the market). For concentrated Korean factor portfolios, EW or score-weighted allocation dominates RP. Do NOT default to RP as an S5 mutation for portfolios with N<=30 Korean stocks.
